about: Hover-card media per project, built by scripts/make-preview.ps1. start and duration are in seconds into the source video. kind 'image' makes posters only. crop is an ffmpeg crop (w:h:x:y, source pixels) applied first; it frames out browser bars, taskbars and page margins.
